name: brisas
description: Plataforma SaaS de gestión residencial multi-conjunto

scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n db,pkg,api,web -c gray,magenta,cyan,green "npm run db:dev" "npm run dev:packages" "npm run dev -w @brisas/api" "npm run dev -w @brisas/web"
scripts.dev:packages: concurrently -n contracts,database "npm run dev -w @brisas/contracts" "npm run dev -w @brisas/database"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @brisas/contracts && npm run build -w @brisas/database
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @brisas/api && npm run build -w @brisas/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck -w @brisas/api && npm run typecheck -w @brisas/web
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test -w @brisas/contracts && npm run test -w @brisas/api
